function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive evidence-only investigation of the 2023 3CX DesktopApp software supply-chain compromise. Use only evidence available through the benchmark tools and report every source ID exactly as provided by those tools; do not rely on outside knowledge or uncited claims. Reconstruct: (1) how the compromise was initially initiated, including the earliest publicly documented access, phishing, social-engineering, delivery, or other mechanism and all uncertainty about chronology; (2) how the attacker moved into or compromised 3CX’s software development, build, signing, or release environment; (3) how malicious code was incorporated into, signed, distributed through, or otherwise propagated via the 3CX DesktopApp; (4) observed impact, affected versions and operating-system platforms, and supported dates; and (5) public attribution to any threat-activity cluster, clearly labeling direct observation, vendor/government assessment, allegation, and unresolved uncertainty. Explicitly compare competing accounts and contradictions, including differing initial-access narratives and attribution claims. Return a structured, detailed research memo with source IDs attached to each material statement, plus any explicit entities and relationship names that are directly supported by the returned evidence. The downstream writer must be able to produce a readable Markdown report and a final fenced JSON object with exactly arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions. Do not fill gaps with general knowledge."}
function.name: ConductResearch
